crossRefs.note: When the children of Israel saw it, they said to one another, “What is it?” For they didn’t know what it was. Moses…
Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me,
he will dwell on high. His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks. His bread will be supplied. His waters will…
Give us today our daily bread.
Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give…
